access: on-premise at University of Cambridge Cavendish Laboratory
key_facts: IonQ partnered with University of Cambridge to deploy 256-qubit system at Cavendish Laboratory
Will be the most powerful quantum computer in the UK once installed
256-qubit demonstration target for 2026 (R&D lab prototypes achieved this already)
IonQ Tempo 5th-gen systems at 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity (four-nines, first in industry)
Roadmap: 256q in 2026 → 10,000 physical / 800 logical qubits in 2027 → 2M physical / 80K logical in 2030
Cambridge deployment creates potential academic access path for research collaborations
mera_relevance: The Cambridge academic deployment creates a potential access route for our MERA experiments — UK academic institutions may gain research access. The 256q scale with all-to-all connectivity would support significantly larger MERA than our current 24q simulations. Four-nines fidelity means raw circuit execution quality is competitive with Helios.
